"''Kill them all.|Captain Phasma and Kylo Ren|audio=PhasmaRen-KillThemAll.flac|}} '''Ilco Munica''' was an [[Abednedo]] [[Gender|male]] who lived as a member of the [[Church of the Force]] in the village of [[Tuanul]] on the [[planet]] [[Jakku]]. When the [[First Order]] [[Attack on Tuanul|attacked]] Tuanul in the [[Standard year|year]] [[34 ABY]] while searching for the vanished [[Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker]], Munica and many other villagers were captured as they tried to defend their homes. After witnessing the [[Death|execution]] of villager [[Lor San Tekka]] and the capture of the [[Resistance pilot]] [[Poe Dameron]], Munica and the other [[prison]]ers were themselves executed by [[First Order stormtrooper|stormtroopers]] under orders from First Order leaders [[Ben Solo|Kylo Ren]] and [[Captain]] [[Phasma]]. ==Biography== ===Villager of Tuanul=== [[File:Munica_surronded.png|thumb|left|250px|Ilco Munica was no match in combat for the stormtroopers of the First Order.]] Originally from the [[planet]] [[Abednedo (planet)|Abednedo]], the [[Abednedo]] [[Gender|male]] Ilco Munica came to live in the sacred village of [[Tuanul]] on the planet [[Jakku]] as an adult. Like the other residents of the village, he was a member of the [[Church of the Force]], a religious group that praised the virtues of [[the Force]] despite not being [[Force-sensitive|able]] to use it. In the [[Standard year|year]] [[34 ABY]], a force of eighty[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'' novelization]] [[First Order stormtrooper|stormtroopers]] serving the [[First Order]] [[Attack on Tuanul|assaulted]] Tuanul. They sought the retired [[Scout|explorer]] [[Lor San Tekka]], a resident of the village who possessed part of a [[Map to Skywalker|map]] that led to the hiding place of vanished [[Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker]]. ===Executed by the First Order=== During the battle, Munica fought back but was outmatched by the First Order's professional [[soldier]]s. Munica screamed as a pair of stormtroopers forced him to his [[Limb|knees]] at [[Blaster|gunpoint]], before he and the village's other survivors were rounded up to huddle in a group. They watched as First Order enforcer [[Ben Solo|Kylo Ren]] arrived and [[Death|executed]] San Tekka upon learning that the old man no longer had the map. The execution prompted [[Resistance pilot]] [[Poe Dameron]], who had been visiting San Tekka, to emerge from hiding and attack Ren, unsuccessfully. [[File:Munica_murdered.png|thumb|right|250px|Ilco Munica was executed by the First Order.]] When Dameron turned out not to have the map either, he was taken [[prisoner]] and dragged to [[Kylo Ren's command shuttle|Ren's shuttle]]. [[Captain]] [[Phasma]], leader of the stormtroopers present in the village, then approached Ren and was given the order to execute the remaining villagers. On the captain's word, the [[trooper]]s surrounding the captives opened fire with their [[F-11D blaster rifle|blasters]], killing Munica and all others present. ==Personality and traits== Ilco Munica had mottled [[Color|pink]] skin, brown [[hair]], and black [[eye]]s. Like all residents of Tuanul, he rejected comforts and luxuries in favor of living an ascetic lifestyle. Munica was not a pacifist, but he chose to only use weapons that he and the other villagers had made themselves instead of those manufactured by large corporations that profited from violence. He was ready to use those weapons to defend his beliefs against the evil influence of the [[dark side of the Force]]. ==Equipment== While living at Tuanul, Munica wore a green [[Clothing|pilgrim's robe]] and a pair of brown insulated [[boot]]s. In battle, he used a [[blaster rifle]] that he had built himself with parts that included a [[pump-action recharger]] and a salvaged industrial [[power shunt]]. The weapon's [[stock]] was weighted and so allowed the weapon to double as a [[war club]]. ==Behind the scenes== [[File:Munica_head_sculpt.png|thumb|right|180px|A sculpt of Ilco Munica's head for ''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'']] Ilco Munica first appeared in the [[2015]] [[sequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']]. The screams and yells of the character were performed by voice actor [[Dee Bradley Baker]],{{SW|url=news/from-blast-that-x-wing-to-traitor-the-voices-of-star-wars-the-force-awakens|text=From "Blast That X-wing!" to "Traitor!": The Voices of ''Star Wars: The Force Awakens''}} best known for voicing all of the [[clone trooper]] characters in ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''.{{SW|url=news/8-star-wars-voice-actors-who-play-multiple-animated-characters|text=8 ''Star Wars'' Voice Actors Who Played Multiple Characters|nolive=1}} The character was not named in the film but was identified in the reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens: The Visual Dictionary]]'', which was released alongside the film and written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]]. Like all members of the Abednedo [[species]] identified by Hidalgo in the ''Visual Dictionary'', Ilco Munica was named in reference to the music of the [[Wikipedia:Beastie Boys|Beastie Boys]], as ''The Force Awakens'' director [[J.J. Abrams]] is a fan of the group and frequently includes their music in his productions. Munica's name is a reference to the album [[Wikipedia:Ill Communication|''Ill Communication'']].{{InsiderCite|165|50 Things to Notice in Star Wars: The Force Awakens|50 Things to Notice in ''Star Wars: The Force Awakens''}} ==Appearances== *{{Film|VII}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *''[[Star Wars Mix & Match]]'' {{Po}} *''[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens: The Visual Dictionary]]'' {{1stID|Ilco Munica}} *''[[Ultimate Sticker Collection: Star Wars: The Force Awakens]]'' *{{Topps|set=2015 Topps Star Wars: The Force Awakens Series 1|cardname=Ilco Munica|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/120020/cid/8229570/2015-Topps-Star-Wars-The-Force-Awakens-15-Ilco-Munico}} *{{SW|url=news/from-blast-that-x-wing-to-traitor-the-voices-of-star-wars-the-force-awakens|text=From "Blast That X-wing!" to "Traitor!": The Voices of ''Star Wars: The Force Awakens''}} {{Imo}} {{C|as Alien Villager}} *{{HelmetCollectionCite|18|Highlights of the Saga}} {{Imo}} *{{InsiderCite|165|50 Things to Notice in Star Wars: The Force Awakens|50 Things to Notice in ''Star Wars: The Force Awakens''|reprint=1}} {{SourceContents|issue={{HelmetCollectionCite|43|parent=1}}|contents= *{{HelmetCollectionCite|43|Helmets}} *{{HelmetCollectionCite|43|Weapons & Uniforms}} }} *''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]'' *{{HelmetCollectionCite|74|Helmets}} {{Po}} *''[[Star Wars: Geektionary: The Galaxy from A - Z]]'' *''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary, New Edition]]'' *{{SWCT|set=2020 Base Series|cardname=Ilco Munica}} *{{EncyclopediaCite|Core Worlds, Colonies, the Inner Rim and Expansion Region}} *{{Databank|ilco-munica|Ilco Munica}} ==Notes and references== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Ilco Munica}} {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |de=Ilco Munica#kanon |fr=Ilco Munica |ja=イルコ・ムニカ |pl=Ilco Munica }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Munica, Ilco}} [[Category:Abednedo]] [[Category:Church of the Force members]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]] [[Category:Males]]
